title: RegistryOntologyEntry
description: The RIGID contract for one entry in architecture/registry_ontology.json#registries. Single source of truth for the entry shape — check_registry_ontology.py reads `required` + `enum` from THIS file and enforces every entry against it, so adding a field or value means editing this schema (not the check). This is the anti-fragmentation rail the owner flagged: 55+ registries cannot drift apart if they all conform to one schema.

holds.description: what knowledge this registry holds, in one line

status.description: live=substantial backing; partial=backing exists but thinner than the vision; gap=no first-class backing

stage.description: the compiler stage the registry serves

maps_to_hub.description: the Open*Hub that exposes it (must exist in hub_profiles.json), or null

backing.description: real repo paths backing this registry; MUST be non-empty + exist on disk for live/partial; MUST be empty for gap

gap_to_close.description: required for partial/gap: what is thin or missing

distinct_from.description: one-line boundary vs near-neighbor registries (avoids overlap/redundancy); cross-cluster rules live in the top-level `boundaries` block
